theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_lattice_chain
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1) → ℝ, (∀ F, ∃ k : ℤ, β F = k) → (∑' F, ENNReal.ofReal (|β F| * ρ ^ (m + 1))) < ∞ → ∃ (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) (v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc ∧ Integrable v ∧ (∀ F, ∀ᵐ x ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))).restrict (latticeFace ρ F)), v x = β F) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), Pc ω = ∫ x, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
